label: Dubstep / Hybrid Trap (Trap Drums, Dubstep Bass)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Cinematic and tense: the intro builds with a low brass-like swell and rolling hats, a snare-roll riser leads to a bouncing first drop, the breakdown cuts to a single sparse pad, and the second drop adds a screeching lead and heavier fills.
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A distorted 808-style sub with glide plays the bass line, layered with a growling mid-bass that answers it, over a tight kick.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM

cards.mood: Confident and menacing: the verses roll over a sparse trap beat with a deep 808, the pre-chorus builds with a riser and snare rolls, the chanted hook leads into a heavy drop, and a late bridge strips to voice and kick before the final,…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male). The vocalist possesses a confident, rhythmic, mid-range rapper's timbre with a slightly hoarse edge.
cards.palette: A deep, gliding 808 bass carries the verses. In the drops a growling mid-bass and a screech lead replace it over a tight sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: A trap-style intro of sparse 808s and rolling hats builds with snare rolls and vocal chops into a brutal, bass-led first drop. A short breakdown leads to a second drop whose kick turns four-on-the-floor for extra speed, and the track ends…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A deep, gliding 808 sub carries the drops, with a distorted growl and a wobble layered on top.
cards.tempo_line: written 145 BPM, felt half-time as 72 BPM
